ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education restrictions and assessments apply, see http://oce.illinois.edu. Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is not recommended. In addition to the online synchronous class sessions, this course will also include face-to-face classes. Meeting dates and locations to be determined by the instructor.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $325.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
